name: EPIC 210314854
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 9.8 solar radii and 0.90 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210314854 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.802782 (16th-84th percentiles 9.567204-10.111761), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,267 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 0.90 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,810 K at its surface.
